modern: Pain is either an evil to the body—then let the body say what it thinks of it—or to the soul; but it is in the power of the soul to keep its own serenity and tranquillity, and not to think that pain is an evil. For every judgement and impulse and desire and aversion is within, and no evil climbs so high.

explained.summary: Pain either hurts the body, in which case let the body deal with it, or it seems to hurt the mind. But the mind can keep its calm by refusing to judge the pain as something evil. Your judgements, choices, desires and aversions are all within you, and no harm can climb that high unless you let it in.
explained.today: With a bad back, a migraine or a slow recovery from surgery, the pain is real, but the extra layer of ’this is unfair, this is ruining everything’ is something you can learn to set down.
